**Fix:** `gridtools/io.py:13` — the loop bound was `range(0, len(edges) - 2)`, an off-by-one that always dropped the last valid cell (not actually odd/even-specific, just wrong for any edge count ≥3). Changed to `range(0, len(edges) - 1)`, matching the documented contract that n edges define n−1 cells.
